concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - the registry has capella:bucket ('the top level of Capella's data hierarchy: bucket > scope > collection') but no server-side bucket concept, despite this page being explicitly named as server's own canonical statement of what a bucket is. notable_absence.finding: The round brief expects Couchbase Server bucket types to include Memcached alongside Couchbase and Ephemeral, but this page states a closed set of exactly two: 'Couchbase Server supports two types of buckets:' followed by only Couchbase and Ephemeral. Grepping all eight pages in this batch for 'memcached' finds a single unrelated hit (the memcached OS process name in storage-settings.md, not a bucket type). Either Memcached buckets have been removed from the product by Server 8.0, or this page's documentation has silently dropped a third bucket type that other doc trees may still reference - worth SME follow-up before the registry treats bucket type as a settled two-member enum anywhere.

cross_component_finding: server:bucket (minted here) and capella:bucket (already promoted, recurrence 13) share a name and a broad role - both are 'the fundamental space for storing data' - but this page states facts capella:bucket's source pages never state: a closed two-member bucket-TYPE axis (Couchbase/Ephemeral) and per-type storage-engine and capability constraints (e.g. 'The bucket storage backends apply only to Couchbase buckets'). No page in either extraction states a relationship between the two ids, so per this round's rule they are kept separate rather than merged - flagged here for reconciliation to decide, joining the registry's existing list of same-name-different-thing collisions (cluster-manager, role, index-ui-status).
